interfaces.description: List of network interfaces on which to listen for mDNS traffic.

mcast_group.description: IPv4 multicast group address used for mDNS (RFC 6762).

port.description: UDP port to bind for mDNS queries and responses.

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable support for IPv6 mDNS (requires mcast_group_v6).

mcast_group_v6.description: IPv6 multicast group address for mDNS (link-local scope). Only used if ipv6_enabled is true.

max_cache_ttl.description: Maximum time (seconds) to cache positive mDNS responses. Prevents stale responses from propagating.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: debug, info, warn, or error.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to syslog/terminal.

rate_limit_qps.description: Maximum mDNS queries per second per source IP. Set to 0 for no limit.

rate_limits_by_iface.description: Per-interface rate limits to override global rate_limit_qps.

blacklist_domains.description: List of domain suffixes to exclude from reflection (e.g., ["_apple-music._tcp.local"], ["local"], ["home.arpa"]).

items.description: Exact domain name or suffix to deny.

whitelist_domains.description: If non-empty, only domains in this list will be reflected (blacklist ignored).

items.description: Exact domain name or suffix to allow.

ptr_reflection.description: Reflect PTR records for reverse DNS (e.g., .in-addr.arpa / .ip6.arpa).

record_ttl.description: TTL (seconds) applied to reflected A/AAAA records.

bind_addr.description: Optional source IP address for outgoing mDNS packets (for multi-homed hosts).

override_ttl.description: If >0, force this TTL on all reflected records (ignores original TTL).
